source_caption_text:
Throwback to King Von writing an emotional letter to his girlfriend in 2018 🥹💌

Behind every gangster, there is this sweet side 🕊️

King Von, born Dayvon Bennett, died on November 6, 2020, after being fatally shot during a confrontation outside Monaco Hookah Lounge in Atlanta, Georgia. A dispute broke out in the parking lot around 3:00 AM between King Von’s crew and another group involving rapper Quando Rondo. The verbal argument quickly escalated into a physical fight and then gunfire.

During the chaos, an associate of Quando Rondo, Timothy Leeks (also known as Lul Timm), shot King Von multiple times. Off-duty police officers stationed nearby responded to the scene and engaged in an exchange of gunfire with those involved. King Von was rushed to a nearby hospital in critical condition but passed away later that day at the age of 26. Charges against the shooter were later dropped under Georgia’s Stand Your Ground law.
